list.metaDescription: Track same-item exchanges your carrier delivers and collects at the customer's door.

hero.title: Exchanges
hero.subtitle: Replacement shipments: the courier takes the new items from you, swaps them at the customer, and brings the old items back. Tracking opens the exchange; order numbers open the order.

empty.title: No exchanges yet
empty.description: Book an exchange from a delivered order to see it here.
empty.searchDescription: Try a different search or filter.

dialog.title: Book an exchange
dialog.description: In one trip the courier picks up the replacement from your pickup location, hands it to the customer, and collects the same items back.
dialog.existingReturn: A return or exchange is already on its way for this order.
dialog.noConnections: None of your shipping partners can exchange parcels.
dialog.connectPartner: Connect a partner that supports exchanges
dialog.nothingLeft: Nothing is left to take back on this order.
dialog.customerMovedHint: Update the delivery address or phone only if they differ from the order.
dialog.itemsHint: Choose how many of each item the courier should swap (same product going out and coming back).
dialog.collectHint: The courier collects this from the customer in cash.
dialog.refundHint: Up to {{max}} EGP remaining on this order.
